Usage: orgtop-e2e --repo OWNER/REPOSITORY [--repo OWNER/REPOSITORY ...] [--path (PATTERN | OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN) ...] [--no-cache]
       orgtop-e2e --path OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN [--path OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN ...] [--repo OWNER/REPOSITORY ...] [--no-cache]
       orgtop-e2e (--org ORGANIZATION | --repo 'ORGANIZATION/*') [...] [--repo OWNER/REPOSITORY ...] [--path OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN ...] [--include-archived] [--include-forks] [--no-cache]
       orgtop-e2e (--org ORGANIZATION | --repo 'ORGANIZATION/*') [...] --repo OWNER/REPOSITORY [--repo OWNER/REPOSITORY ...] --path PATTERN [--path PATTERN ...] [--path OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN ...] [--include-archived] [--include-forks] [--no-cache]
       orgtop-e2e --reset-cache
       orgtop-e2e --version

Flags:
  --repo owner/repository
        select an exact GitHub owner/repository; repeat the flag to select several
  --path (PATTERN | OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN)
        select a path pattern; a bare PATTERN filters every --repo selection, a qualified OWNER/REPOSITORY:PATTERN stands alone; repeat the flag to select several
  --org (ORGANIZATION), --repo 'ORGANIZATION/*'
        select every eligible repository of a GitHub organization; repeat the flag to select several
  --include-archived
        include archived repositories when expanding organization selectors
  --include-forks
        include forked repositories when expanding organization selectors
  --no-cache
        run without opening, reading, or writing the enrichment cache
  --reset-cache
        remove OrgTop's cached enrichment state and exit; accepts no other flag
  --version, -v
        print the release version and exit

Rain windows:
  -/+ select a shorter or longer window: 15m, 30m, 60m, 6h, 24h, 7d, available
        a session starts at 24h; each finite window drops an event at that exact age
        available keeps every event of the last refresh, which is the newest 100
        events per repository GitHub returned, not complete repository history
        Interesting Now samples the last 15m as a Scope-fair recent-event sample,
        not an importance ranking

Enrichment cache:
  changed-file evidence is reused from orgtop/enrichment-v1.db under the user
        cache directory, beside its enrichment-v1.lock maintenance lock
        it stores no credential, header, or raw payload, and it is disposable:
        deleting it changes request volume, never what a Scope matches
        a record stays usable for 30 days; bounded cleanup removes invalid and
        expired records first, then the least recently used, at 10,000 records,
        250,000 paths, or 128 MiB
  --no-cache runs one process without it, --reset-cache removes it and exits
        a cache that is unusable degrades to direct GitHub requests and shows
        CACHE DEGRADED rather than failing the refresh

GitHub requests:
  one request per selected repository per refresh, out of the 5000 REST requests
        an authenticated token gets per hour
        changed-file enrichment may spend at most 20 changed-file requests more
        per refresh; cache hits and deduplicated work spend none
        an exhausted limit shows RATE LIMITED with the instructed retry time and
        leaves path membership unknown; unknown membership is never guessed
at least one --repo owner/repository, --path owner/repository:pattern, or --org organization selection is required
